name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Pizza Tower Music Pack
summary:
Get saucy with the OFFICIAL Pizza Tower Music Pack!

Featuring FOUR new Rhythm Rifts for:
- "It's Pizza Time!" by Mr. Sauceman
- "The Death That I Deservioli" by Mr. Sauceman
- "Unexpectancy, Pt. 3" by Mr. Sauceman
- "World Wide Noise" by ClascyJitto

Each Rhythm Rift comes with:
- A fully-bopping Peppino Spaghetti character
- Background visualizer with pizza toppings particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design.
